_doc: Every HTTP surface the Worker serves. `python3 -m foundation standards --check` fails when index.js serves a path that is not listed here, and the conformance tests fail when a discoverable surface is missing from /llms.txt, the OpenAPI document or the agent card. A new surface is registered here in the same change that adds it.
